topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Well now, I heard tell that the blacksmith's lad had his carriage taken away, right out of his own yard! Folk say a stranger came, with a contraption bigger than any plow, and hauled it off. The poor lad was standin' there, mouth agape, like a fish outta water. Said he didn’t know how it come to be. Mind you, there’s talk ‘round the village that the carriage wasn’t his own, and maybe the rightful owner come to claim it. Still, to see it go like that, it’s a queer thing. I reckon the saints must be in a temper today, else why would such a strange event befall our quiet village?
